{{Top|leg}}
The '''Essence Stealer''' was a device invented by [[Borborygmus Gog]] as part of [[Project Starscream]]. It was designed to rip the [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-essence out of a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] body and contain it in a giant computer-linked [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] matrix. Its victims' bodies were stored in [[Stasis pod|stasis pods]] while their essence was collectively held in a crystal globe similar to [[Golden Globe|the one]] used by [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]] to imprison the souls of [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] children on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin IV]].<ref name=":0">[[File:HyperspaceIcon.png|link=Hyperspace:_The_Official_Star_Wars_Fan_Club|16x16px]]&nbsp;[[Droids, Technology and the Force: A Clash of Phenomena (article)|Droids, Technology and the Force: A Clash of Phenomena]] on [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] <small>(article) (content obsolete and backup link not available)</small></ref>

Gog used the technology from a [[Ssi-ruu|Ssi-Ruuvi]] [[Swarm-class battle droid|''Swarm''-class battle droid]] that he had purchased from [[Raith Sienar/Legends|Raith Sienar]]. He worked to discover the secrets of Ssi-Ruuvi [[entechment]] to learn how to strip a being of their life-force and transfer it to a mechanical construct. By combining his discoveries with the rare [[Soul snare|soul-snares]] used by the [[Shaman/Legends|shamans]] of the [[Order of the Terrible Glare/Legends|Order of the Terrible Glare]], he succeeded in making the Essence Stealer. He placed it in the Jedi library on the [[Nespis VIII]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] to lure and trap Jedi for study. Despite not being able to successfully trap a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], Gog was still able to endlessly study the life-forces of the other beings he managed to ensnare. Building on the research of [[Jenna Zan Arbor]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] scientists harnessed the energy field the crystal matrix created and tested it. They found that its power was so incredible that no other energy source could rival it. A curiosity they discovered was that [[Beskar/Legends|Mandalorian iron]] could not be affected by the Force energy field. The Force-sensitive [[Human/Legends|Human]], [[Tash Arranda/Legends|Tash Arranda]], managed to destroy it with the help of her uncle, [[Mammon Hoole]]. The spirits contained inside it were returned to their bodies if they were still preserved, or became one with the Force.<ref name=":0" /> 

The insane [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]], [[Umak Leth]] used the research gathered from the Essence Stealer and the discovery of Mandalorian iron's Force resistance to develop the [[Universal Energy Cage]].<ref name=":0" />
